scope: Current manuscript citation identities; primary metadata checked 2026-09-26

verified_title_and_identifier.note: Official ICML 2012 accepted-paper listing confirms title and four authors; BibTeX has no URL or DOI.
Repository CITATION.cff and README recommend exactly the BibTeX author, title, and 2018 year; the repository display heading is a separate descriptive tagline.
BibTeX publication year 2023 matches Crossref; 2022 in key and DOI reflects identifier history, not reference year.

BibTeX year and official proceedings are 2025; 2024 is only a legacy internal key.

venue_residue.comment: The citations to WorldGym (ICLR 2026) and Progress or Regress (ICLR 2025) are legitimate references, not submission-venue residue.

method: Parsed the 21 keys from the built bibliography and checked presence in references.bib. Fetched official PMLR and ICLR proceedings, arXiv abstract records, the official ICML 2012 accepted-paper listing, the project repository's CITATION.cff and README, and Crossref DOI registration metadata. Matched citation titles and identifiers; checked publication years where venue metadata was available. A successful LaTeX build alone was not treated as proof of bibliographic correctness.
limitations: This audit checks identity and core metadata of the 21 cited sources; it does not validate every claim in surrounding prose, all uncited BibTeX entries, or every page range.
